cases.name: scalar_local_level
cases.purpose: Scalar baseline with nonzero process and observation noise.

cases.name: local_linear_trend_regression
cases.purpose: Two-state local-linear-trend regression y=[0,2,-1,3,0]; the alternating observations expose the historical smoother indexing bug.

cases.name: correlated_multivariate
cases.purpose: Two states and two jointly observed channels with non-diagonal Q and R, a dense H, and nonzero transition and observation offsets.

cases.name: partial_and_all_missing
cases.purpose: Partial and fully missing rows exercise observed H/R submatrices and the predict-through-all-missing convention.

contract.all_missing_time: update is identity and loglik increment is zero, then transition still runs
contract.filter_covariance_crosscheck: sequential deep check uses Joseph covariance
contract.full_innovation_covariance: H*P_pred_t*H' + R for every channel, including missing channels
contract.initial_state: initial mean/covariance are the t=0 pre-observation prediction
contract.innovation: full-length vector with null at missing channels
contract.loglik: observed components only; each increment is log density of the observed prefix through t minus the prefix through t-1
contract.missing_values: JSON null; partial updates use the observed H rows and R principal submatrix
contract.parameter_time_dependence: F, c, Q, H, d, and R are constant across time
contract.transition: after updating t, predict t+1 with F*x_t + c and F*P_t*F' + Q

generator.sha256_canonicalization: logical source bytes with CRLF and CR normalized to LF

oracle.authoritative_method: Construct the full joint Gaussian mean/covariance of x_0..x_{T-1} and y_0..y_{T-1}, then directly condition x_t on observed y blocks.
oracle.matrix_solver: Decimal Cholesky factorization and triangular solves

provenance.derivation: Joint multivariate-normal block conditioning; no Kalman recurrence in expected-value generation.
provenance.fixture_design: Hand-authored deterministic decimal inputs; no random generator.

rust_replay.policy: Tolerances are approximately four times the measured Rust replay maxima on 2026-09-03.

validation.output_stability_rule: Decimal trees encoded at 64 significant digits must be exactly identical for 80->120 and 120->180 digit recomputation.

sequential_joseph_rts_crosscheck.method: A separate sequential Joseph-form Kalman filter and RTS recursion is compared against the authoritative block-conditioned results at 80, 120, and 180 digits.
